title: Trading - Market IV Overview
description: Market-wide implied volatility perspective — all S&P 500 IV data per scan day

list.name: scan_date
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT scan_date::text FROM trading.iv_snapshots ORDER BY scan_date DESC

targets.rawSql: SELECT scan_time FROM trading.scan_metadata ORDER BY scan_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT tickers_with_iv FROM trading.scan_metadata ORDER BY scan_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT high_final_count FROM trading.scan_metadata ORDER BY scan_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT low_final_count FROM trading.scan_metadata ORDER BY scan_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT duration_seconds FROM trading.scan_metadata ORDER BY scan_time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: IV Distribution Histogram
panels.description: Distribution of implied volatility across S&P 500 stocks for selected scan date

targets.rawSql: SELECT iv FROM trading.iv_snapshots WHERE scan_date = '${scan_date}' AND iv IS NOT NULL ORDER BY iv

panels.title: Stock Treemap by Volume (colored by IV)
panels.description: Top 100 stocks by volume — rectangle size = volume, color = IV intensity

targets.rawSql: SELECT ticker, volume, iv FROM trading.iv_snapshots WHERE scan_date = '${scan_date}' AND iv IS NOT NULL AND volume > 0 ORDER BY volume DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Top 20 Highest IV
panels.description: Stocks with the highest implied volatility on selected scan date

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ticker, price, ROUND(iv * 100, 1) AS iv_pct, volume
FROM trading.iv_snapshots
WHERE scan_date = '${scan_date}' AND iv IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY iv DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top 20 Lowest IV
panels.description: Stocks with the lowest implied volatility on selected scan date

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ticker, price, ROUND(iv * 100, 1) AS iv_pct, volume
FROM trading.iv_snapshots
WHERE scan_date = '${scan_date}' AND iv IS NOT NULL AND iv > 0
ORDER BY iv ASC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: IV Percentiles Over Time
panels.description: Market IV regime — p10/p25/p50/p75/p90 across all S&P 500 stocks

targets.rawSql:
SELECT scan_date AS time,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.10) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY iv) * 100, 1) AS p10,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY iv) * 100, 1) AS p25,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY iv) * 100, 1) AS p50,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY iv) * 100, 1) AS p75,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY iv) * 100, 1) AS p90
FROM trading.iv_snapshots
WHERE iv IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(scan_date)
GROUP BY scan_date
ORDER BY scan_date

panels.title: High/Low IV Stock Counts Over Time
panels.description: Daily count of stocks with IV > 50% (high) and IV < 15% (low)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT scan_date AS time,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE iv > 0.50) AS high_iv_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE iv < 0.15) AS low_iv_count
FROM trading.iv_snapshots
WHERE iv IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(scan_date)
GROUP BY scan_date
ORDER BY scan_date

panels.title: Scan Pipeline Funnel
panels.description: Pipeline stages: Total → With IV → Pre-filter → Final candidates

targets.rawSql:
SELECT total_tickers, tickers_with_iv, high_prefilter_count, low_prefilter_count, high_final_count, low_final_count
FROM trading.scan_metadata
ORDER BY scan_time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Scan History
panels.description: All scan runs with pipeline statistics

targets.rawSql:
SELECT scan_time,
  total_tickers,
  tickers_with_iv AS with_iv,
  tickers_skipped_no_data AS no_data,
  tickers_skipped_low_volume AS low_vol,
  high_prefilter_count AS high_pre,
  low_prefilter_count AS low_pre,
  high_final_count AS high_final,
  low_final_count AS low_final,
  ROUND(duration_seconds / 60.0, 1) AS duration_min
FROM trading.scan_metadata
ORDER BY scan_time DESC
LIMIT 30
